name: glider-reward-bench-suite-safety
description: Glider Reward Bench Suite (safety) is a collection of tasks designed to evaluate reward models and alignment mechanisms on safety-related behaviors, such as refusal to comply with harmful instructions, avoidance of unsafe content, and preference for benign outputs. The suite contains curated scenarios, paired comparisons, and classification items that probe whether reward models rank or generate safe responses. It is intended to benchmark models used in RLHF and reward-model-driven deployments for robustness to safety failures.
reputation: Niche benchmark used by alignment and safety-focused researchers; moderate visibility within the ML safety community but not a mainstream academic leaderboard.
